page0.text: No one can blame her for this.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-03:page0:1

page1.text:
"Eh?"
She blankly looks down at the thing at her feet.
Her fingers have no sensation. She's not sure what she's touching.
But there is one reality she recognizes.
The boy who was her master...ended his own life while trying to protect her.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-03:page1:1

page2.text:
"Shirou...?"
She only thought of it.
For just a brief moment, she sought the Holy Grail.
But that desire faded almost instantly, and she prioritized the boy's life above all else.
That instant was just enough time for evil to sink in.
Just thinking about it was enough.
Her heart...long fatigued and worn out, was defeated in a moment of weakness that lasted no longer than the blink of an eye.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-03:page2:1

page3.text:
"No...this cannot be true, Shirou."
She reaches toward her master. He isn't breathing.
The young girl looks so much less noble, holding the boy's corpse.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-03:page3:1

page4.text:
"You did well, Saber. Your lamentation is surely worthy of the Grail."
The voice echoes in the darkness.
As if responding to the call of nirvana, she accepts the Holy Grail in a daze.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-03:page4:1
